# AIVA FLOW

> AI-powered project management platform that helps modern teams automate task generation, prioritize work, and track progress.

AIVA FLOW combines a Kanban board, ideas inbox, AI assistant, analytics, and team collaboration features in one workspace.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, and how it works.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create a new AIVA FLOW account.
- [Log in](/login): Access an existing account.
